english:
Using your Class Ability while Initiative is active creates a stationary Healing Drone. It immediately releases a healing pulse, then pulses every 2 seconds in a 7 meter radius. Each pulse restores 10 HP per Initiative stack, with up to 5 pulses per Class Ability use.

The drone has no collision but can block projectiles.

source.text:
4 Piece | Healing Initiative

On Class Ability Usage while Initiative is active:
Creates a stationary Healing Drone that restores HP every 2 seconds in a 7 meter radius. Instantly releases the first pulse on usage.
Healing Drone restores 10 HP per Initiative stack per pulse up to 5 times per Class Ability Usage.
Healing Drone has no collision but can block projectiles.
